name: Geo Targetly Geo Consent
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Show the right cookie consent banner to the right visitors based on their location. Geo Consent helps your website stay compliant with privacy regulations like GDPR (Europe), CCPA (California), LGPD (Brazil), PIPEDA (Canada), and others, without showing unnecessary banners to users outside the scope.

Create fully customized, geo-targeted consent forms in just a few clicks via our dashboard. Then, simply embed the provided JavaScript snippet into your WordPress site.

You can auto-apply location-based templates or define your own rules. Geo Consent supports Google Consent Mode, tracks & stores visitor consent, and lets you choose how long to remember user preferences.

Made by Geo Targetly, it’s the fastest way to meet regional cookie compliance laws with full flexibility.

  • Paid account is required – see pricing
  • 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Show cookie banners by country or region, and avoid unnecessary consent prompts
  • Prebuilt support for GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, PIPEDA, and more
  • Full design customisation to match your website branding
  • Display consent forms in local languages automatically
  • Store and track user consent preferences
  • Add optional links to your privacy policy
  • Integrates with Google Consent Mode (v2)
  • Choose when banners should reappear after dismissal
  • Lightweight, fast-loading script integration
  • No coding knowledge needed, just copy and paste

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/geo-consent
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/10587397-geo-consent-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/11547892-geo-consent

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g594253005.co to load and run a script that powers its core functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

Additionally, this plugin connects to analytics endpoint https://g97676560.co/ to track plugin installation and usage over time.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
